blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】Mystic Star公開！
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Mystic Star Released!

blocks.source: （ファイルサイズ：約７１．５MB）
blocks.translation: (File size: approximately 71.5 MB)

blocks.source: （ダウンロードして展開後、本体があるフォルダ内にパッチの中身をコピー＆上書きしてください。）
blocks.translation: (After downloading and extracting it, copy and overwrite the patch contents into the folder containing the main game files.)

blocks.source: 古い作品なので現在のWindows環境では起動時にエラー（DirctDraw Error）が発生する模様です。
blocks.translation: As this is an old game, it appears that an error (DirctDraw Error) occurs at startup on current Windows systems.

blocks.source: なお、本作は将来的なリメイク版（英語対応予定）の販売を計画しています。そちらを待って頂いてもよいかと思います。なお、まだ計画段階なので詳細は決まっていません。
blocks.translation: I am planning to release a remake of this game in the future (with English support planned). You may wish to wait for that version. However, it is still only in the planning stage, so no details have been decided yet.

blocks.source: 元がフリゲなので雲海のフロンティアよりはかなり安くします。完成はどんなに早くても２０２７年末以降になる予定です。
blocks.translation: Since the original was freeware, I will make it considerably cheaper than Cloudsea Frontier. Completion is scheduled for the end of 2027 at the earliest.

blocks.source: 解凍した本体フォルダの中にあるRPG_RT.exe
blocks.translation: RPG_RT.exe in the extracted main game folder

blocks.source: を実行してください。全画面モードで起動します。ウィンドウモードでプレイしたい場合はF4を押してください。
blocks.translation: and run it. It will start in fullscreen mode. Press F4 if you want to play in windowed mode.

blocks.source: このゲームは通常のWindows環境ならば単体で動作します。ＲＴＰなどのインストールは不要です。
blocks.translation: This game runs on its own in a standard Windows environment. There is no need to install RTP or anything else.

blocks.source: 少しだけ複雑なシステムなので、同梱の説明書（
blocks.translation: Since the system is somewhat complex, I tried to write the included manual (

blocks.source: ）をできるだけ丁寧に書いてみました。ゲーム中でも人物のセリフを通して、システムの説明をしていますが、わかリにくいという場合は説明書をご覧ください。
blocks.translation: ) as carefully as possible. The game also explains the system through the characters' dialogue, but if you find it difficult to understand, please refer to the manual.

blocks.source: バグなどありましたら、ご連絡ください。
blocks.translation: Please let me know if you find any bugs or other issues.

blocks.source: 以下、内容紹介です。
blocks.translation: Here is an introduction to the game.

blocks.source: 内容紹介
blocks.translation: Introduction

blocks.source: プレイ時間２０～３０時間程度の王道長編ＲＰＧです。素材はグラフィックも音楽もほぼ自作。作品規模・雰囲気共に、昔なつかしＳＦＣ時代の市販ＲＰＧに匹敵するものを目指しました。
blocks.translation: This is a classic long-form RPG with an estimated playtime of 20–30 hours. I created almost all of the assets myself, including the graphics and music. In both scale and atmosphere, I aimed to match the commercial RPGs of the nostalgic SNES era.

blocks.source: 過去に公開したLabyrinth Starはこれの外伝ですが、未プレイでも問題ありません。あくまでMystic Starこそが本編であり、単体で完結する作品です。あちらについては興味があればMystic Starの後にでもプレイして頂ければと思います。
blocks.translation: Labyrinth Star, which I released in the past, is a side story to this game, but you can play Mystic Star without having played it. Mystic Star is the main story and is a self-contained game. If you are interested in Labyrinth Star, I hope you will play it after Mystic Star.

blocks.source: 王道ＲＰＧといえばフィールドです。中盤以降、船を手に入れてからは自由度もそれなりにあります。
blocks.translation: A classic RPG needs a world map. From the middle of the game onward, after obtaining a ship, you will have a fair amount of freedom.

blocks.source: サイドビューの戦闘（いわゆるＣＴＢ形式）やメニュー画面を独自に実装。
blocks.translation: A side-view battle system (the so-called CTB format) and menu screen were implemented from scratch.

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウント制を採用。様々なダンジョンが登場します。
blocks.translation: The game uses symbol encounters. Various dungeons await you.

blocks.source: スキルシステムです。どの技を先に覚えるか色々考えてみて頂ければ。
blocks.translation: It features a skill system. I hope you enjoy considering which techniques to learn first.

blocks.source: Labyrinth Starから引き続き魔珠システムも登場します。魔物を倒して手に入れた魔石を元に魔珠を合成します。魔法を覚えたり、能力を上昇させる効果があります。
blocks.translation: The mage orb system from Labyrinth Star also returns. You synthesize mage orbs using magic stones obtained by defeating monsters. They allow you to learn magic and increase your abilities.

blocks.source: もちろんストーリーも王道です。ベタです。愉快な仲間達との冒険が繰り広げられます。斬新さはありませんが、冒険感を味わえるものにしたつもりです。ちなみに主人公のハルトは無口主人公ですが、影が薄いとか言わない。
blocks.translation: Of course, the story is also classic. It is straightforward. An adventure with a delightful group of companions unfolds. It is not innovative, but I intended to create something that conveys the feeling of adventure. Incidentally, the protagonist Haruto is a quiet protagonist, so don't say he lacks presence.

blocks.source: 手に汗握るボス敵との戦い。特に中盤からは強敵が多数登場します。強力な二種類の奥義を使い分けることが戦いのコツです。
blocks.translation: Thrilling battles against boss enemies. Especially from the middle of the game onward, many formidable foes appear. The key to victory is switching between the two powerful Arts.

blocks.source: 豆知識
blocks.translation: Trivia

blocks.source: ①ボス戦前のイベントはスキップすることができます。イベントが開始する際の画面暗転時に『シフトキー』を押しっぱなしにしてみてください。
blocks.translation: ①Events before boss battles can be skipped. Try holding down the Shift key while the screen fades to black as the event begins.

blocks.source: ②今回はLabyrinth Starにあった難易度設定はありません。後半の難易度は結構高いので見合わせました。クリア後に『ハード』と『エクストラ』を選択することができるようになります。二周目のプレイをすることも可能ですし、ラスボスを倒した後、裏ボス代わりに『エクストラ』でもう一度挑んでみるということも可能です。
blocks.translation: ②Unlike Labyrinth Star, this game has no difficulty settings at the start. I decided against including them because the latter half is already quite difficult. After clearing the game, you will be able to choose Hard or Extra. You can play through a second time, or after defeating the final boss, you can challenge Extra once more as a substitute for a secret boss.

blocks.source: ……といいながら、どうしてもという方のために隠しコマンドを設けました。『シフトキー』を押しながら『NEW GAME』を選んでみてください。
blocks.translation: …That said, I added a hidden command for those who absolutely want one. Try selecting NEW GAME while holding down the Shift key.

blocks.source: 謝辞
blocks.translation: Acknowledgments

blocks.source: 開発に当たって、テストプレイについて多数の方にご協力を頂きました。また、フリー素材やフリーソフトも利用させて頂きました。詳細は添付の説明書に明記しております。その他にも長～い開発期間において、多数のご声援を頂きました。皆様、ありがとうございました！
blocks.translation: During development, many people helped with playtesting. I also made use of free assets and free software. Details are provided in the included manual. In addition, I received tremendous encouragement from many people throughout the long development period. Thank you, everyone!

texts.を実行してください。全画面モードで起動します。ウィンドウモードでプレイしたい場合: and run it. It will start in fullscreen mode. Press F4 if you want to play in windowed mode.
texts.このゲームは通常のWindows環境ならば単体で動作します。ＲＴＰなどのインスト: This game runs on its own in a standard Windows environment. There is no need to install RTP or anything else.
texts.少しだけ複雑なシステムなので、同梱の説明書（: Since the system is somewhat complex, I tried to write the included manual (
texts.）をできるだけ丁寧に書いてみました。ゲーム中でも人物のセリフを通して、システムの: ) as carefully as possible. The game also explains the system through the characters' dialogue, but if you find it difficult to understand, please refer to the manual.
texts.バグなどありましたら、ご連絡ください。: Please let me know if you find any bugs or other issues.
texts.以下、内容紹介です。: Here is an introduction to the game.
texts.プレイ時間２０～３０時間程度の王道長編ＲＰＧです。素材はグラフィックも音楽もほぼ: This is a classic long-form RPG with an estimated playtime of 20–30 hours. I created almost all of the assets myself, including the graphics and music. In both scale and atmosphere, I aimed to match the commercial RPGs of the nostalgic SNES era.
texts.過去に公開したLabyrinth Starはこれの外伝ですが、未プレイでも問題あ: Labyrinth Star, which I released in the past, is a side story to this game, but you can play Mystic Star without having played it. Mystic Star is the main story and is a self-contained game. If you are interested in Labyrinth Star, I hope you will play it after Mystic Star.
texts.王道ＲＰＧといえばフィールドです。中盤以降、船を手に入れてからは自由度もそれなり: A classic RPG needs a world map. From the middle of the game onward, after obtaining a ship, you will have a fair amount of freedom.
texts.サイドビューの戦闘（いわゆるＣＴＢ形式）やメニュー画面を独自に実装。: A side-view battle system (the so-called CTB format) and menu screen were implemented from scratch.
texts.シンボルエンカウント制を採用。様々なダンジョンが登場します。: The game uses symbol encounters. Various dungeons await you.
texts.スキルシステムです。どの技を先に覚えるか色々考えてみて頂ければ。: It features a skill system. I hope you enjoy considering which techniques to learn first.
texts.Labyrinth Starから引き続き魔珠システムも登場します。魔物を倒して手: The mage orb system from Labyrinth Star also returns. You synthesize mage orbs using magic stones obtained by defeating monsters. They allow you to learn magic and increase your abilities.
texts.もちろんストーリーも王道です。ベタです。愉快な仲間達との冒険が繰り広げられます。: Of course, the story is also classic. It is straightforward. An adventure with a delightful group of companions unfolds. It is not innovative, but I intended to create something that conveys the feeling of adventure. Incidentally, the protagonist Haruto is a quiet protagonist, so don't say he lacks presence.
texts.手に汗握るボス敵との戦い。特に中盤からは強敵が多数登場します。強力な二種類の奥義: Thrilling battles against boss enemies. Especially from the middle of the game onward, many formidable foes appear. The key to victory is switching between the two powerful Arts.
texts.①ボス戦前のイベントはスキップすることができます。イベントが開始する際の画面暗転: ①Events before boss battles can be skipped. Try holding down the Shift key while the screen fades to black as the event begins.
texts.②今回はLabyrinth Starにあった難易度設定はありません。後半の難易度: ②Unlike Labyrinth Star, this game has no difficulty settings at the start. I decided against including them because the latter half is already quite difficult. After clearing the game, you will be able to choose Hard or Extra. You can play through a second time, or after defeating the final boss, you can challenge Extra once more as a substitute for a secret boss.
texts.……といいながら、どうしてもという方のために隠しコマンドを設けました。『シフトキ: …That said, I added a hidden command for those who absolutely want one. Try selecting NEW GAME while holding down the Shift key.
texts.開発に当たって、テストプレイについて多数の方にご協力を頂きました。また、フリー素: During development, many people helped with playtesting. I also made use of free assets and free software. Details are provided in the included manual. In addition, I received tremendous encouragement from many people throughout the long development period. Thank you, everyone!
texts.・アスダイン城の宝を重複配置していたので修正。: ・Fixed the duplicate placement of treasure in Asdain Castle.
texts.・宿屋に泊まる際に所持金を表示。: ・The player's money is now displayed when staying at an inn.
texts.・カーソルの動作を青ターミナルで調整可能に。: ・Cursor movement can now be adjusted at the blue terminal.
texts.・一部ダンジョンの脱出座標の誤りを修正。: ・Fixed incorrect escape coordinates in some dungeons.
texts.・システム説明の町人位置を調整。: ・Adjusted the positions of townspeople who explain the system.
texts.・スキル習得後にシフトでキャラ交代すると習得状況が即時反映されないバグ修正: ・Fixed a bug where learned skills were not reflected immediately when switching characters with Shift after learning a skill.
texts.・スキル習得直後に決定キーを押すと挙動が怪しいバグを修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused strange behavior when pressing the confirm key immediately after learning a skill.
texts.・赤青ターミナルの選択肢順序を調整。: ・Adjusted the order of choices at the red and blue terminals.
texts.・アイテム入手時のウェイトをわずかに延長。: ・Slightly extended the wait time when obtaining an item.
texts.・ロビンのスキル習得順序の誤りを修正。: ・Fixed an error in Robin's skill learning order.
texts.・サロマナに忘れていた住民を追加。: ・Added residents who had been omitted from Saromana.
texts.・店画面のカーソル動作＆レイアウト微調整。: ・Made minor adjustments to cursor movement and layout on the shop screen.
texts.・赤青ターミナルを自作メニュー化してカーソル設定を可能に。: ・Converted the red and blue terminals into a custom menu, enabling cursor settings.
texts.説明書も少しだけ修正。: Also made a few minor corrections to the manual.
texts.・メニュー画面の細かい動作調整。: ・Made minor adjustments to the menu screen's behavior.
texts.・クリア後のスキル関連の引継処理を修正。: ・Fixed the skill-related carryover process after clearing the game.
texts.・ドーピング後に回復で数値表示位置がズレるバグを修正。: ・Fixed a bug where the number display position shifted when recovering after doping.
texts.・特定条件でドーピングに失敗するバグを修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused doping to fail under certain conditions.
texts.・武闘大会の副賞をイベント終了後ももらえるように。: ・Made it possible to receive the martial arts tournament's bonus prize even after the event ends.
texts.・魔王城のイベントで稀に進行不能になるバグを修正。: ・Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented progress during an event at the Demon King's Castle.
texts.・魔珠店の装備数が実態と一致しないバグを修正。: ・Fixed a bug where the number of equipped mage orbs in the mage orb shop did not match reality.
texts.・ラスダンのボス戦でイベントスキップすると: ・If you skip the event during the final dungeon boss battle,
texts.一気にエンディングになってしまうバグ修正。: fixed a bug that caused the game to immediately proceed to the ending.
texts.・大地の穴で空中遊泳できるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that allowed you to swim through the air in the Earth Hole.
texts.・予約した特技を手動習得後、裏で予約状態が継続しているバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where a reserved Tech remained reserved in the background after being learned manually.
texts.・最強スコップ装備時に鍛冶屋の表示がおかしくなるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused the blacksmith's display to become corrupted when the strongest shovel was equipped.
texts.・武闘大会のエントリー時に４人未満でおかしくなるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused problems when entering the martial arts tournament with fewer than four people.
texts.・全滅時復活地点の誤り修正。: ・Corrected the revival location after a party wipe.
texts.・全滅時の減少カーネをやや軽減。: ・Slightly reduced the amount of Kane lost after a party wipe.
texts.・撹乱の魔珠・スキルが機能しないバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that prevented the Confusion mage orb and skill from functioning.
texts.・撹乱のバグ修正に伴うバランス調整。: ・Adjusted the balance following the fix for the Confusion bug.
texts.・特定条件でキャラグラの表示がおかしいバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused character graphics to display incorrectly under certain conditions.
texts.・封印神殿の脱出処理がおかしいバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug affecting the escape processing in the Sealed Temple.
texts.・序盤のバランス微調整。: ・Slightly adjusted the balance in the early game.
texts.・初回の炎四天王を撃破すると逆に粗品がもらえないバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where defeating the Fire Four Heavenly Kings for the first time paradoxically prevented you from receiving a small gift.
texts.・店を開いた直後にキャンセル連打すると異常な画面になるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused an abnormal screen to appear when repeatedly pressing cancel immediately after opening a shop.
texts.・最初の森で全滅すると脱出できるようになるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that allowed you to escape after being wiped out in the first forest.
texts.・敵の異常耐性を微調整。: ・Slightly adjusted the enemies' status ailment resistances.
texts.・特定条件でライエン将軍が会話しないバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where General Raien would not speak under certain conditions.
texts.・土四天王イベント後のフリーズバグに対処。: ・Addressed a freezing bug that occurred after the Earth Four Heavenly Kings event.
texts.・脱出時に稀にラスダンが消えるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where the final dungeon would occasionally disappear when escaping.
texts.・後半イベントで帝都教会前の老人が無反応なバグを修正。: ・Fixed a bug where the old man in front of the Imperial Capital church did not respond during a later event.
texts.・ラウアーの町の魔法説明を進行に応じて更新。: ・Updated the spell descriptions in Raua Town according to story progress.
texts.・仲間離脱時に無人パーティができるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that created an empty party when an ally left.
texts.・メルシア城内から井戸に戻ると戦闘音楽がそのままなバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where the battle music continued playing when returning to the well from inside Melsia Castle.
texts.・パーティ解散時に編成すると同キャラが二人表示されるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where two copies of the same character appeared when forming a party after disbanding one.
texts.・七星の地図を上向き以外で取るとキャラ配置がおかしいバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where the character placement was incorrect when obtaining the Seven Star Map while facing any direction other than up.
texts.・雪森、雪山に着陸できるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that allowed landing in the Snow Forest and Snow Mountain.
texts.・土星珠、月星珠入手直後に全滅できないように修正。: ・Prevented party wipes immediately after obtaining the Earth Star Orb or Moon Star Orb.
texts.・マックスの家で泊まると、こっそりお金を取られるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where staying at Max's house secretly took your money.
texts.・メルシア地下の宝箱を開けると色が変わるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug where opening a treasure chest in the Melsia Underground changed its color.
texts.・七星珠の入手順序による会話変化を調整。: ・Adjusted dialogue changes based on the order in which the Seven Star Orbs are obtained.
texts.・敵の召喚が失敗するバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused enemy summons to fail.
texts.・ロビン登場イベントの条件を二周目用に調整。: ・Adjusted the conditions for Robin's appearance event for the second playthrough.
texts.・イベント進行順序の不具合修正。: ・Fixed an issue with the order of event progression.
texts.・ヘルファイア（複合属性）のダメージ処理を修正。: ・Fixed the damage processing for Hellfire (combined attributes).
texts.・異常な場所移動が発生するバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused abnormal location transfers.
texts.・ボス戦全滅→復活後にすり抜け状態になるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that left the player in pass-through mode after being wiped out in a boss battle and revived.
texts.・敵を倒して全滅させずに逃げるとＳＰが多く入るバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that awarded too much SP when fleeing after defeating enemies without wiping out the entire enemy group.
texts.・船の乗降と同時に戦闘になると挙動が怪しいバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused strange behavior when boarding or disembarking from a ship at the same time as entering battle.
texts.・ハシゴ状態から脱出すると向き固定のままになるバグ修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused the player's direction to remain locked when exiting ladder mode.
texts.・氷月イベントにおける全滅復活地点を修正。: ・Fixed the revival location after a party wipe in the Ice Moon event.
